g.title: The Matrix Awakens
g.desc: Trial menu-video-audio. Title code reached. Frame verified. Unresolved imports in loaded DLLs: 1

g.title: Xbox library coverage
g.text: 16 tracked DLLs · TuxBox and reference providers

g.title: d3d12_xs.dll · Partial · TuxBox Rust D3D12 provider. The retail run uses patched TomBox. TuxBox creates a device for profile 0x20002 and submits two guest command lists with verified output. The reference path accepts Frosty's 0x20004 profile and renders the menu and movies.

dxcompiler_xs.dll · Partial · TuxBox PE forwarder to desktop DXC. DxcCreateInstance supplies a working IDxcUtils factory. A 257-byte blob retained its contents and lifetime across interface releases on Valve and GE-Proton.

xmem.dll · Partial · TuxBox Rust allocator. The retail reference run uses TomBox. Six named and ordinal exports cover allocation/free, working-set statistics and virtual allocation. Guest tests check alignment, reservation, page access and lifetime.

xg_xs.dll · Partial · TuxBox texture address computer. Computes linear and 4 KiB tiled layouts for single-slice 2D textures in six formats. The same guest matched the supplied library on 13 layouts and 273,263 texel or compressed-block addresses, including four shapes from Frosty's placed-resource trace.

xgameruntime.dll · Partial · ScarlettX reference runtime with a task-queue fix. Frosty initializes the reference runtime and enters Unreal startup. A paired control verifies termination of a queue with a manual completion port.
xcrdapi.dll · Partial · TomBox storage bridge to desktop DirectStorage. DStorageGetFactory supplies the storage path Frosty uses to initialize its I/O dispatcher and mount its IoStore container.

gameconfighelper.dll · Partial · TuxBox package registry helper using Win32 and WinRT. Implements two of the 24 exports in the reviewed Windows Game Runtime helper. The guest obtains an owned UTF-16 package path and opens configuration keys in both supported registry hives. Boundary lengths, Unicode and missing keys matched the supplied helper.

GameInput.dll · Partial · TomBox GameInput bridge with TuxBox mouse and keyboard mapping. The retail menu accepts keyboard, mouse and Xbox D-pad input. A virtual Xbox controller verifies analog readings, simultaneous button presses, hotplug and keyboard fallback through Proton XInput.
AcpHal.dll · Partial · TomBox audio hardware abstraction. Frosty starts its mixer and submits an eight-channel buffer with the reference AcpHal provider.

XAudio2_9.dll · Partial · TuxBox Xbox ordinal exports backed by system XAudio2. Seven exports cover all five static imports in Frosty. The guest creates engines through both factory ordinals, instantiates three effects, pans a source and measures the signal on each stereo channel.

GameChat2.dll · Partial · TuxBox in-process chat manager. Eight exports implement session setup and cleanup, a remote-user roster, locality and encoding bitrate. Seven are among Frosty's 15 delay imports. The guest checks duplicates, capacity, removal and stale handles against the supplied DLL.

mfplat.dll · Partial · TuxBox sample bridge with TomBox and Proton Media Foundation. The bridge provides the D3D12 video-sample path. Guest readback and retail movie comparisons verify decoded output.

mfhevcdec.dll · Partial · TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied HEVC decoder. The adapter delivers synchronized D3D12 NV12 samples. Original intro and chase footage passed decoded-frame comparisons.
mfh264dec.dll · Partial · TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied H.264 decoder. The registered H.264 transform returns D3D12 samples for both 1024 × 512 menu previews.

mfreadwrite.dll · Partial · TuxBox synchronous PCM source reader. Console ordinal 5 opens a seekable RIFF/WAVE byte stream. The guest compares 2,501 stereo frames and checks stream selection, seeking, timestamps, end of stream and invalid inputs.

MSAudDecMFT.dll · Partial · TuxBox AAC transform adapter using GE-Proton's host decoder. Handles the first format change and end-of-stream drain. On GE-Proton the guest decoded 25 generated and 96 Frosty AAC-LC packets into 48 kHz six-channel PCM. Each channel was compared with FFmpeg.
Guest regression checks
